inputs.prompt: Inspect the actual image. Return only a JSON object with description and tags. The description must be a concise, specific account of visible subjects, setting, composition, colors, lighting, medium and style. Describe what is visible without inventing identities or hidden context. The tags array must contain 1 to 8 distinct short lowercase tags useful for finding this stock image, including subjects and visual characteristics. Use 1-4 words per tag. Example: {"description":"A small red boat on a calm lake beneath misty mountains, rendered in soft watercolor.","tags":["red boat","lake","misty mountains","watercolor","soft light"]}.
inputs.system_prompt: You label images for a style reference library. Inspect the actual image. Return valid JSON only.
